Frequently asked questions

Which restaurants accept EBT in Grand Rapids?

Grand Rapids has 16 restaurants authorized for the SNAP Restaurant Meals Program, including Popeyes, Lions Subs, Raiders Subs, Papa John's. Each accepts EBT from eligible recipients for prepared meals.

Can anyone use EBT at these Grand Rapids restaurants?

No — only recipients enrolled in the Restaurant Meals Program: those who are 60 or older, have a disability, or are experiencing homelessness (and their spouses). Michigan is a participating state.

What can I buy with EBT at a restaurant in Grand Rapids?

Hot and ready-to-eat meals. Alcohol, tobacco and non-food items aren't covered, and most states don't allow EBT to pay tips. It draws from your regular SNAP balance.
